name: @tumult/desktop
description: Tumult, a Matrix chat client (desktop app)
author: Jack Graddon

scripts.pretest:smoke: pnpm --filter @tumult/core build && pnpm --filter @tumult/theme build && node scripts/build-web.ts --fake && node scripts/build.ts
scripts.prepackage: pnpm --filter @tumult/core build && pnpm --filter @tumult/theme build && node scripts/build-web.ts && node scripts/build.ts
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run prepackage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run prepackage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
